Dosage Form(s): This monograph excludes foods or food-like dosage forms as indicated in the Compendium of Monographs Guidance Document.
The acceptable dosage forms are indicated in Table 1 below.

Quantity(ies): Notes
The maximum daily dosage has been listed in Table 1 to allow flexibility in terms of single dose and frequency per day. However, doses should generally be taken in 1 to 4 divided doses throughout the day.
A statement such as "or as recommended/indicated by a health care practitioner/health care provider/health care professional/doctor/physician" may be added after the recommended dose (e.g., Take 3 to 5 globules, 2 to 3 times per day, or as indicated by a health care practitioner).
Please refer to the Evidence for Homeopathic Medicines guideline for more information.

Direction(s) for use: When the statement "or as recommended/indicated by a health care practitioner/health care provider/health care professional/doctor/physician" is not included as part of the recommended dosing (optional)
Use/Take as directed by a health care practitioner/health care provider/health care professional/doctor/physician.
For globules, pills, pellets, granules, tablets - Infants and children less than 2 years old
Infants/children less than 2 years old, dissolve dose in a small amount of water before administration.
Topical preparations such as cream, liniment, ointment, gel
Apply to the affected area(s), as needed.
Other optional instructions for consumers
The directions for use may include additional information such as instructions on the time intervals between doses or dosing for an acute phase [e.g., Take 3 to 5 globules, 2 to 3 times daily. During the acute phase, take 1 dose, every 15 to 60 minutes (do not exceed 12 doses per day). Once symptoms improve, reduce the dose and return to the general dosage].

Caution(s) and warning(s): Ask a health care practitioner/health care provider/health care professional/doctor/physician if symptoms persist or worsen.
Ask a health care practitioner/health care provider/health care professional/doctor/physician before use if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.
And
Any ingredient specific risk statement when required as per the NHPID.
